clues.text: In the Valley of Sorek, a woman lulled him to sleep on her lap and had his seven braids shaved off.
Near the vineyards of Timnah, the Spirit of the LORD came on him and he tore apart a roaring young lion.
At Lehi the ropes fell from his arms, and he struck down a thousand Philistines with a donkey's jawbone.
Bracing against two central pillars, he pushed with all his might and brought a Philistine temple down on its lords.
He tied torches between the tails of three hundred foxes and burned the Philistines' standing grain.
At midnight in Gaza, he pulled up the city gate, doors and posts, and carried it to a mountain overlooking Hebron.
During a seven-day feast, he bet thirty linen garments on a riddle about something sweet coming out of the strong.
